title: 艾略特增持德国电信，反对T-Mobile合并
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: You're also reporting on the latest moves from Elliott, Deutsche Telekom and T-Mobile.
segments.zh: 你也在报道Elliott、德国电信和T-Mobile的最新动向。

segments.en: They had been, at least Deutsche Telekom, had been positioning in order to merge its American arm, again T-Mobile, Elliott management, hitting out, saying that they don't
segments.zh: 至少德国电信一直在布局，以合并其美国子公司T-Mobile，而Elliott管理层则抨击这一策略，表示他们不赞同。

segments.en: agree with that strategy. What exactly is Elliott doing and saying?
segments.zh: Elliott具体在做什么、说了什么？

segments.en: Yeah, Elliott really doesn't want to see this merger. That we were very excited about for deal watches like us, Emily reporters, especially. This is a very exciting transaction,
segments.zh: 是的，Elliott真的不希望看到这次合并。对我们这样的交易观察者，尤其是记者来说，这是一笔非常令人兴奋的交易。

segments.en: a potential combination of Deutsche Telekom and T-Mobile would be one of the largest public MLA deals ever, the largest in fact ever in public markets, it would create the largest
segments.zh: 德国电信与T-Mobile的潜在合并将成为有史以来最大的公开市场并购交易之一，实际上可能是最大的，将打造最大的移动通信公司。

segments.en: mobile company, one worth well over $200 billion. But Elliott thinks that Deutsche Telekom
segments.zh: 市值将远超2000亿美元。但Elliott认为德国电信可以更好地利用其现金储备。

segments.en: could be using its cash reserves better, they want to see the company step up, share by bags and do other things to improve shareholder returns rather than pursuing this very ambitious
segments.zh: 他们希望公司加大权益资产回购力度，并采取其他措施提升股东回报，而不是追求这项雄心勃勃的合并。

segments.en: merger. And this merger is honestly not without its detractors, there have been reports already about T-Mobile execs being concerned about this merger, it will also need approval from Germany
segments.zh: 而且这项合并并非没有反对者，已有报道称T-Mobile高管对此表示担忧，合并还需获得德国和美国的批准。

segments.en: and the US, the German government has about a 28% stake in Deutsche Telekom, so it will need sort of explicit German government approval. So there are a lot of moving parts here, it's not a deal that will
segments.zh: 德国政府持有德国电信约28%的股份，因此需要德国政府的明确批准。这里有很多变数，不是一笔容易完成的交易。
